messages.author: 299a5089d6c6c523
messages.subject: Re: shinyapps and textreadr are not compatible?
parts:
textreadr depends upon antiword which depends upon sys which requires the system package libapparmor-dev to be installed on Ubuntu Linux, which is what shinyapps.io uses.

http://docs.rstudio.com/shinyapps.io/getting-started.html#system-packages
